title: Postmortem Analysis
definition: A thorough examination of a failed model's performance to identify and address its shortcomings for future improvements.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Think of it as a 'lessons learned' document after a project fails. It outlines what went wrong, what was missing, and what should be improved for the next attempt.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: A process of investigating a failed model to understand the reasons behind its failure, focusing on the Spec, pair generation, filtering, training, and evaluation stages.
difficulty_levels.expert: A systematic method of evaluating a failed model, identifying the root cause of its failure, and using that insight to improve future models. It involves categorizing failures into Spec-level, Pair-level, Filter-level, Training-level, Evaluation-level, and identifying what worked and what was missing.

extra_fields.insight: Identifying the root cause of a model's failure is the most valuable information for improving the next iteration.
